intent: User accepts general risk-avoidance handling; May, July and September are regression cases, never parameter-selection targets.
return_definition: One continuous compounded capital ledger. Retain the previously confirmed arithmetic mean >=10% on May/July/September; report geometric growth separately, without silently making geometric 10% a new user requirement.
risk_acceptance: Each May-September monthly marked-to-market net return must be >=0; also report the three named regression cases separately. Zero-trade cash cannot pass the 10% return requirement.
selection_entry_cutoff: Only entries whose full 14-calendar-day contractual expiry precedes 2026-05-01
selection_admission: All 12 selection months complete and nonnegative; at least 12 completed trades; no pending position at selection end.
regression_policy: Freeze one best policy using selection data only before any May-September risk replay. Evaluate that policy once; no retry or parameter change based on regression outcomes. Evaluate cash and legacy v2 only as diagnostics.
exit_contract: Attach +5% regular-session limit at fill. Risk stops may exit earlier; 14 inclusive calendar days remains the maximum. Conservative stop-first assumption if both barriers occur in one 5m bar; favorable excursion can raise the stop only at the first regular bar start strictly after the completed trigger bar available_at plus 30 seconds (usually two bars later). Stops execute at min(bar Open, stop trigger) less slippage, including gap losses.
profit_protection: Breakeven trigger accounts for round-trip fees and sell slippage; it is a modeled threshold, not a guaranteed fill or monthly loss floor. A gap below it remains a loss.
capital: One position; fixed entry fraction of settled cash; reserve cash retained. Reuse sale proceeds next official session, no same-day reentry. A losing exit blocks the next N full sessions. No negative-month clipping, removal, month-reset capital or excluded losses.
costs: Reuse v2 5bps commission each side, 5bps regular market slippage. Double all costs as a diagnostic with the same frozen policy.
deployment: No new-buy admission unless both selection admission and all historical regression gates pass. These remain development gates, not prospective guarantees. Existing position management remains available.
implementation_repair: Profit-protection update activation now includes observed historical bar availability and 30-second order latency. Original run retained; no rule, threshold or size was chosen from regression results.
